method.journey_times: TfL Journey Planner API (api.tfl.gov.uk/Journey/JourneyResults), queried 2026-11-01 for Monday 3 Nov 2026, arrive by 08:45, journeyPreference=LeastTime, modes tube/national-rail/overground/dlr/elizabeth-line/walking. 'min' is the shortest total journey returned (station to station, including TfL's interchange/walk allowances). Totals include TfL's interchange and walking allowances (e.g. 9-11 min Vauxhall rail-to-tube walk, 8 min Waterloo-Waterloo East walk), so some figures are conservative. The API response was truncated for some queries; where the shortest journey's later legs were cut off the note says so and gives the fully-shown alternative.
method.coordinates: Wikipedia station articles (WGS84 decimal), except Kingston (TfL StopPoint API, NaPTAN).
method.season_tickets: For stations inside TfL zones, the adult Monthly Travelcard for zones 1-N from TfL's 'Fares from 1 March 2026' (MD3464): 7 Day price x 3.84 rounded up to 10p (TfL's stated formula). Rail-only National Rail 'London Terminals' seasons could not be fetched (operator and BRFares calculators are JavaScript-only), so Epsom and St Albans City are null.
